title: Sega Saturn Choice Cuts
overview:
Sega Saturn Choice Cuts is a video sampler disc of Saturn games. There are no playable demos; instead the disc plays about a minute of gameplay footage from each of twelve titles, along with promotional material.

Featured games:
- Black Fire
- Bug!
- Clockwork Knight
- Daytona USA
- Myst
- NHL All-Star Hockey
- Panzer Dragoon
- Pebble Beach Golf Links
- V.R. Virtua Racing
- Virtua Fighter
- Worldwide Soccer
- Solar Eclipse
